blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many modern language models have adopted hybrid architectures that incorporate both linear-time recurrence and softmax attention. Modern recurrence layers provide a highly expressive mixing mechanism while ensuring high throughput by compressing contextual information into a fixed-size state, but underperform softmax attention in contextual information retrieval. In this paper, we reveal a Competing Learning phenomenon where different kinds of mixers compete to learn the same function, and when any layer learns a function, it suppresses the corresponding learning signal for other layers. Layer attribution analysis reveals that under typical data distributions, modern recurrence learns retrieval functions faster than softmax attention, causing attention to fail to learn retrieval in most cases. Stopping weight updates in recurrence in the middle of training helps attention learn retrieval. Based on these results, we propose a staged training procedure for pre-training hybrid architectures on natural language. Empirical results on models up to 1B parameters show that our method results in substantial improvement in language modeling loss, common-sense reasoning, as well as a wide range of retrieval-related tasks across different context lengths.
blocks.zh: 许多现代语言模型都采用了混合结构,既包含线性-时间重现,又包含软最大注意力. 现代重现层提供了高度表达性的混合机制,同时通过将上下文信息压缩成固定大小状态来确保高吞吐量,但在上下文信息检索中却表现得软马克斯注意力不足. 在本文中,我们揭示出一种相竞的学习现象,不同种类的混音器竞相学习同一种功能,当任何一层学习到一个功能时,它会压制其他层的相应学习信号. 地层归属分析显示,在典型的数据分布下,现代再生学习回取功能的速度快于软最大注意力,导致注意力在多数情况下无法学习回取. 在培训中停止重现时更新重量有助于注意力学习检索。 基于这些结果,我们提出了关于自然语言的混合结构培训前阶段培训程序。 最多可达1B参数的模型的实证结果显示,我们的方法在语言模型丢失,常识推理,以及不同上下文长度的广泛检索相关任务等方面都得到大幅改进.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recently, many open-weight large language models (LLMs) have adopted hybrid architectures that combine two distinct types of token mixers: linear recurrence (e.g., state space models (SSMs) and linear attention) and softmax attention ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . Such models have demonstrated strong language modeling capabilities while offering improved training and inference efficiency, scaling to models with up to trillions of parameters. Representative examples include Kimi K3 ( Team Kimi et al., 2026 ) , GLM-5.3-Flash ( GLM Team, 2026 ) , Qwen3.8-Flash-Next ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , and Nemotron-3-Ultra ( NVIDIA Team, 2026 ) .

blocks.en: Prior work has shown that, in well-trained LLMs, different token mixers—and/or different heads within the same mixer—can specialize in distinct mixing patterns. For instance, Xiao et al. (2025) show that a subset of attention heads in Transformer models ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , referred to as retrieval heads , learn long-distance mixing patterns, whereas other heads primarily capture short-distance interactions. Similarly, Bick et al. (2025) show that different heads within a linear recurrence layer exhibit retrieval behaviors over different distances. In hybrid architectures, Chen et al. (2026) further show that assigning long-distance retrieval to softmax attention and short-distance mixing to recurrent layers is beneficial across a wide range of downstream tasks. Together, these findings motivate a division of labor in hybrid models, where softmax attention specializes in long-distance mixing while recurrent layers specialize in short-distance mixing.
blocks.zh: 以往的工作表明,在训练有素的有限责任公司中,不同的代号搅拌器——和/或同一搅拌器内不同的头——可以专门处理不同的搅拌模式。 例如,Xiao等人(2025年)表明,变形金刚模型(Vaswani等人,2017年)中的一个子集关注头,称为取回头,学习长距离混合模式,而其他头主要捕捉短距离相互作用. 同样, Bick等人(2025年)显示,线性重现层内不同的头部显示不同距离的取回行为. 在杂交结构中,Chen等人(2026年)进一步表明,将长途检索分配给软最大注意力和将短途混合到反复层对下游范围广泛的任务都是有益的. 这些发现加在一起,激发了混合模型中的分工,软马克斯的注意力专门用于长距离混合而经常性地层专门用于短距离混合.

blocks.en: In this work, we identify Competing Learning , a phenomenon in which layers that acquire retrieval capabilities earlier inhibit the development of these capabilities in other layers. In the hybrid models we study, recurrent layers tend to gain this early advantage, taking over retrieval-related functions that softmax attention layers are intended to specialize in. Consequently, training hybrid models using standard practices results in softmax attention’s retrieval learning being limited by recurrent layers, leading to suboptimal division of labor.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们确定了竞争学习(Competting Learning),在这个现象中,早期获得检索能力的地层会抑制这些能力在其他地层的发展. 在我们所研究的杂交模型中,常态层往往获得这种早期优势,取而代之的是柔和的注意力层所要专门研究的与检索相关的功能. 因此,使用标准做法的培训混合模式导致软功率关注的检索学习受到重复层的限制,导致劳动分工不理想。

blocks.en: Concretely, we provide an analysis based on layer-wise contribution attribution on synthetic retrieval tasks to identify the speed of retrieval learning of different mixers in a hybrid model. The analysis provides evidence to illustrate how the learning of retrieval functions in softmax attention is inhibited by the retrieval learning of recurrent layers. Furthermore, manually stopping recurrent layers from learning retrieval at different points in the training process reveals that softmax attention starts learning retrieval as soon as recurrent layers’ learning is stopped. We also discover that under typical training distributions, with more short-distance patterns than long-distance ones, recurrence learns retrieval faster than softmax attention, resulting in suboptimal division of labor.
blocks.zh: 具体而言,我们根据对合成检索任务的分层贡献归属进行分析,以确定在混合模型中不同搅拌器的检索学习速度。 该分析提供了证据,以说明如何通过反复层的检索学习来抑制在软最大注意力中学习检索功能. 此外,在培训过程中的不同阶段,手动阻止经常层的学习检索显示,一旦停止经常层的学习,软最大注意力就开始学习检索。 我们还发现,在典型的训练分布下,比起长途模式,再生学习回取比软马克斯注意力快,导致劳动分工不理想.

blocks.en: To address this issue, we propose Better Layer Division (BLD), a training pipeline that introduces a preliminary training stage before standard pretraining to give full-attention layers an early advantage in learning retrieval. This intervention is designed to steer Competing Learning in favor of full-attention layers, encouraging them to assume the long-range retrieval role during subsequent pretraining. We evaluate BLD on widely used benchmarks (e.g. Common-sense reasoning (CSR), recall-intensive tasks, LongPPL ( Fang et al., 2025 ) .) using hybrid models based on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) 2 2 2 Widely-used RNN architecture adopted by frontier models (e.g. Kimi K3, GLM-5.3-Flash). ( Kimi Team et al., 2025 ) at multiple scales, and observe improvements in benchmarks including CSR, recall-intensive tasks, RULER, LongPPL and training loss over vanilla ones.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提议改进地层司(BLD),这是一个培训管道,在标准预训之前引入一个初步培训阶段,使全心全意的地层在学习检索方面及早获得优势。 这种干预旨在引导竞争学习有利于全心全意的层次,鼓励它们在随后的预训中承担远程检索角色. 我们根据广泛使用的基准(如常识推理(CSR),召回密集型任务,LongPPL(Fang等,2025年).)来评价BLD,使用基于Kimi Delta Content(KDA)2 2的被广泛使用的RNN架构被前沿模型采用(如Kimi K3,GLM-5.3-Flash)的混合模型. (Kimi Team等人,2025年),在多个尺度上,并观察到基准的改进,包括企业社会责任、召回密集型任务、欧盟驻科法治团、LongPPL和训练损失等。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • We investigate the training dynamics of layer-wise functional specialization in hybrid models, focusing on the allocation of retrieval-related functions between recurrent and full-attention layers. • We identify and characterize Competing Learning through empirical analyses, revealing how early differences in retrieval learning influence subsequent layer specialization. • We propose BLD, an LLM training pipeline that guides functional specialization by freezing the parameters of selected components during the early stage of pretraining, and verify its effectiveness on hybrid models at multiple scales and with different recurrent architectures. Empirical results show that BLD produces pretrained LLMs with performance gains on a wide range of tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下: 我们调查了混合模型中分层功能专业化的训练动态,重点是在经常性和全心全意层次之间分配检索相关功能. —— 我们通过经验分析确定和定性竞争学习,揭示早期检索学习的差异如何影响随后的层层专业化。 我们提出BLD,这是一个LLM培训管道,通过在预训的早期阶段冻结选定组件的参数来指导功能专业化,并通过多种规模和不同的经常性架构来验证其在混合模型上的有效性. 经验结果显示,BLD生产出经过预先训练的LLMs,在一系列广泛任务上的性能收益.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent LLMs increasingly adopt hybrid architectures that combine softmax attention with linear attention, including GLM-5.3-Flash ( GLM Team, 2026 ) , Kimi K3 ( Team Kimi et al., 2026 ) , Qwen3.8-Flash-Next ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , and Nemotron-3-Ultra ( NVIDIA Team, 2026 ) . Such designs combine the retrieval strength of softmax attention with the computational efficiency of linear attention. Prior work has shown that linear or recurrent models can underperform softmax attention on precise in-context retrieval ( Arora et al., 2024 ; Bick et al., 2025 ; Jelassi et al., 2024 ) . Several works improve the memory or retrieval capabilities of linear attention through architectural or state-space enhancements ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Qin et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, our work does not enhance the retrieval capacity of linear attention itself, but improves the pre-training of hybrid models without architectural modifications. Hybrid architectures instead retain softmax-attention layers for long-range retrieval while using efficient linear attention for most computation ( Kimi Team et al., 2025 ) . Our work focuses on better realizing this architectural complementarity during pre-training. Most of our experiments are conducted on Kimi-Linear-style models based on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) ( Kimi Team et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 近期的LLMS越来越多地采用将软马克斯注意力与线性注意力相结合的混合结构,包括GLM-5.3-Flash(GLM Team,2026年),Kimi K3(Team Kimi等,2026年),Qune3.8-Flash-Next(Quen Team,2026年)和Nemotron-3-Ultra(NVIDIA Team,2026年). 这种设计结合了软马克斯注意力的检索强度和线性注意力的计算效率. 先前的研究表明,线性模型或再生模型在准确的文本检索方面可能表现得不够注意软度(Arora等,2024;Bick等,2025;Jelassi等,2024)。 若干作品通过建筑或状态空间增强提高了线性注意力的内存或取回能力(杨等,2023;杨等,2025b;秦等,2024;沈等,2026). 相形之下,我们的工作并没有增强线性关注本身的取回能力,而是改进了混合模型的预训而无需进行建筑改造. 混合结构反而保留了可进行远程检索的软最大注意层,同时在大多数计算中使用高效的线性注意(Kimi Team等,2025年)。 我们的工作重点是在培训前更好地实现这种建筑互补性。 我们的大多数实验都是基于Kimi Delta注意力(KDA)(Kimi Team等,2025年)的Kimi-Linear风格模型进行的.

blocks.en: Prior work has shown that only a small subset of attention heads develops strong long-context retrieval behavior ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . DuoAttention exploits this functional specialization by distinguishing retrieval heads from streaming heads for efficient inference ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) . Other works leverage already-formed retrieval heads to construct post-training signals for improving long-context performance and contextual faithfulness ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Ma and Okazaki, 2026 ) . Recent studies further analyze how retrieval heads are learned or evolve during context extension and long-context continual pre-training ( Zhao et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) . These works mainly study or exploit specialization among homogeneous softmax-attention heads, rather than the allocation of retrieval capability across heterogeneous attention components. In hybrid models, however, such allocation is critical: if all retrieval heads emerge in linear-attention components, the intended architectural advantage of combining efficient linear attention with the stronger retrieval capability of softmax attention would be largely undermined.
blocks.zh: 先前的研究表明,只有一小部分关注头发展出强烈的长文本检索行为(Wu等,2025年)。 DuoAttenty通过区分取回头与流出头的取回头来利用这种功能上的专业性,以便有效推论(Xiao等,2025年). 其他作品利用已经形成的检索头来构建培训后信号来提高长文本的性能和背景的忠诚度(Huang等人,2025;Ma and Okazaki,2026.). 最近的研究进一步分析了在上下文扩展和长篇连续预训期间如何学习或发展检索头(赵等,2024;梁等,2026)。 这些工作主要研究或利用同质软性注意头的专业化,而不是将检索能力分配给不同的注意部分。 然而,在混合模型中,这种分配至关重要:如果所有检索头都以线性注意元件出现,那么将高效的线性注意与更强的取回能力相结合的预期建筑优势将在很大程度上被削弱.

blocks.en: Prior work has observed functional specialization between attention and recurrent components in hybrid models, with attention playing a particularly important role in exact retrieval and recall ( Bick et al., 2025 ; Afendulev et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . These works mainly characterize specialization after it has emerged, while other studies exploit such specialization to construct hybrid models from pretrained Transformers ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Bick et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, we study how this division of labor forms during hybrid-model pre-training and how it can be actively optimized. In the work most closely related to ours, Qiao et al. (2026) show that efficient-attention modules can weaken the optimization pressure for full-attention layers and delay retrieval-head formation. Our work further identifies the underlying competition in retrieval-specific learning signals: linear-attention and softmax-attention layers both gradually acquire retrieval capabilities, and layers that learn retrieval earlier reduce the retrieval-specific prediction error, thereby weakening the learning signal available to other layers. We refer to this as the Competing Learning phenomenon and use it to guide pre-training toward stronger retrieval specialization in softmax-attention layers.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作观察到了混合模型中注意力和经常性元件之间的功能性特殊性,注意力在准确检索和召回方面发挥着特别重要的作用(Bick等,2025;Afendulev等,2026;Wang等,2025.). 这些作品主要表现为专业化出现后的专业化,而其他研究则利用这种专业化,从被预先训练的变形器构造出混合模型(Chen等,2026;Bick等,2026;Li等,2026). 相比之下,我们研究了这种劳动分工在混合模式预训期间的形式,以及如何积极优化. 在与我们最密切相关的作品中,Qiao等(2026年)显示高效的注意模块会削弱全注意层的优化压力并延迟取回头形成. 我们的工作进一步确定了检索特定学习信号的根本竞争:线性意向和软性意向层都逐渐获得检索能力,而更早学习检索的地层会减少检索特定预测错误,从而削弱其他地层可用的学习信号. 我们将此称为相互竞争的学习现象,并用它来指导前期培训,使柔性最大注意层的检索专业化程度更强。

blocks.en: To show the causes and effects of this phenomenon, we conduct a series of layer attribution and gradient intervention experiments to monitor the retrieval learning of each layer in a hybrid model. In the following sections, we first propose a synthetic retrieval task (Section 3.1 ). Then, we propose a novel metric for determining how much a layer contributes to the model’s retrieval abilities (Section 3.2 ). Finally, we train a series of hybrid models on this task and inspect the contributions of each layer to monitor their retrieval learning over time (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 为了显示这种现象的原因和影响,我们进行了一系列地层归属和梯度干预实验,以监测在混合模型中每个地层的检索学习. 在以下各节中,我们首先提出合成检索任务(第3.1节)。 然后,我们提出了一个新的衡量标准,用以确定一层在多大程度上有助于模型的检索能力(第3.2节)。 最后,我们就这项任务培训一系列混合模型,并检查每一层的贡献,以监测其长期检索学习(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: Concretely, we conduct the following three sets of experiments: • Section 3.3.1 : We provide the experimental evidence for the Competing Learning phenomenon with weight freezing. • Section 3.3.2 : We provide direct gradient evidence for the Competing Learning phenomenon through weight freezing and unfreezing. • Section 3.3.3 : We show how the distribution of short and long-distance patterns chooses the winner of Competing Learning phenomenon. Altogether, we demonstrate the existence of Competing Learning in hybrid models and that KDA layers learn modeling short-distance patterns faster than attention layers. Since short-distance patterns are more frequent than long-distance patterns in natural language pretraining ( Futrell et al., 2015 ) , this leads to a suboptimal labor division in direct pretraining of hybrid models.
blocks.zh: • 第3.3.1节: 我们提供实验性证据 以冻结体重来证明竞争的学习现象 • 第3.3.2节: 我们通过冻结体重和解冻为竞争学习现象提供直接梯度证据。 • 第3.3.3节: 我们展示短途和长途模式的分布如何选择竞争学习现象的取胜者. 总体而言,我们证明了混合模型中存在相竞学习,KDA层比关注层更快地学习了短距离模式. 由于短途模式在自然语言预训中比长途模式更频繁(Futrell等,2015年),这导致在直接预训混合模式中出现次优分工.

blocks.en: 3.3 Analysis Experiments
blocks.zh: 3.3 分析实验

blocks.en: With the above task and estimation method, we can now perform a series of experiments to analyze the phenomenon of Competing Learning for hybrid models, which is central to our paper.
blocks.zh: 有了上述任务和估计方法,我们现在可以进行一系列实验,分析为混合模型而相竞学习的现象,这是我们论文的核心.

blocks.en: We train several hybrid models on the Spaced Retrieval task. Each model has 3.6M parameters and consists of two KDA (a widely-used linear recurrence architecture) layers and two attention layers. Unless specified otherwise, we use 1:1 mixtures of examples with g = 64 g=64 and g = 8192 g=8192 . During training, we only compute the loss on output tokens using loss masks. Here, we report the results for g = 8192 g=8192 , but we emphasize that the results of g = 64 g=64 are similar. The results for g = 64 g=64 and more experimental details can be found in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 我们在太空检索任务上训练了几种混合型号. 每个模型有3.6M参数,由两个KDA(被广泛使用的线性再生架构)层和两个关注层组成. 除非另有说明,我们使用1:1的示例混合物,克=64克=64克;克=8192克=8192克。 在训练期间,我们只用损失口罩计算出输出符上的损失. 在这里,我们报告g=8192克=8192的结果,但我们强调g=64克=64的结果类似. g=64克=64的检测结果和更多实验细节见附录A.

blocks.en: Without intervention, KDA layers become dominant in terms of retrieval ability in this setting, as shown in Figure 3 . To investigate how their dominance affects the attention layers, we freeze all KDA layers at different training steps and continue training the remaining model components. As shown in the left part of Figure 4 , the attention layers’ retrieval ability increases sharply immediately after each freezing intervention. This observation is consistent with the hypothesis that, once KDA layers acquire some retrieval capability, they suppress the acquisition of the same capability by attention layers, providing evidence for the Competing Learning phenomenon.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,如果不进行干预,KDA层在这一背景下的检索能力就变得占主导地位。 为了调查它们的主导地位如何影响关注层,我们冻结所有KDA层在不同的培训步骤上,并继续培训其余的模型组件. 如图4左部分所示,每次冻结干预后,注意力层的检索能力立即急剧提高。 这种观察符合这样的假设,即一旦KDA地层获得一定的检索能力,它们会抑制被注意地层获得同样的能力,为相竞学习现象提供证据.

blocks.en:
Furthermore, we explore how unfreezing KDA layers at a later training step influences learning competition. In the right plot of Figure 4 , runs in which KDA is frozen earlier than step 125 have higher retrieval ability than when the KDA remains frozen for the rest of the training, while runs in which KDA is frozen later than step 125 have lower retrieval ability than when the KDA remains frozen. Moreover, these changes appear almost immediately after KDA is unfrozen. This clear polarization may be attributed to the fact that attention layers in checkpoints where freezing began earlier than step 125 have enough retrieval advantages by freezing KDA layers long enough.
At these early freezing checkpoints, attention layers have already accumulated a sufficient advantage in retrieval performance, substantially outperforming KDA layers. Consequently, once freezing is lifted, attention layers tend to further reinforce their retrieval capabilities, while KDA layers are driven to specialize in other functions. This is reflected in Figure 4 : at checkpoints where attention layers have established a sufficiently strong advantage, their retrieval ability further improves after unfreezing. In contrast, at checkpoints where this advantage is insufficient, attention layers are once again outcompeted by KDA layers, leading to a decline in their retrieval ability.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们探讨以后培训阶段解冻KDA层如何影响学习竞争。 在图4的正确图中,KDA被冻结的时间比第125步早,其检索能力比KDA为其余训练被冻结的时间要高;而KDA被冻结的时间比第125步早,其检索能力比第125步被冻结的时间要低。 此外,这些变化几乎在KDA解冻后立即出现。 这种明显的两极分化可能归因于这样一个事实,即冻结开始时间早于第125步的检查站的注意层通过冻结足够长的KDA层具有足够的取回优势。
在这些早期被冻结的检查站,注意层在检索性能方面已经积累了足够的优势,大大超过KDA层。 因此,一旦解除冻结,注意层往往会进一步加强其检索能力,而KDA层则被驱动专门从事其他功能。 图4反映了这一点:在注意层已确立足够强大优势的检查站,其取回能力在解冻后得到进一步提高。 与此相反,在这种优势不足的检查站,注意力层再次被KDA层所超越,导致其检索能力下降。

blocks.en: In hybrid models, KDA and attention layers compete to learn retrieval, with KDA initially gaining an advantage due to its stronger inductive bias toward short-range patterns. Temporarily freezing the dominant KDA layers can shift—and, with sufficient duration, even reverse—the winner of this competition.
blocks.zh: 在混合模型中,KDA和注意力层竞争学习回取,由于KDA对短程模式的更强烈的诱导偏好,最初获得了优势. 暂时冻结主导KDA的地层可以改变——并且有足够的时间甚至反向改变——这场比赛的获胜者。

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Gradient Evidence of Competing Learning
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 竞相学习的渐进证据

blocks.en: Figure 5: Relative gradient magnitude changes in the Attention layers compared to the baseline without KDA freezing. KDA is frozen at steps 100, 150, or 175, with an unfreezing branch introduced 50 steps later. Across these timings, keeping KDA frozen progressively amplifies attention gradient norms relative to the baseline, whereas unfreezing KDA substantially attenuates this amplification.

blocks.en: We further investigate how the freezing intervention affects gradient dynamics. As shown in Figure 5 , the gradient norm of the attention layers in the frozen checkpoint reaches approximately 10 × 10\times that of the baseline checkpoint, which has never undergone freezing. Moreover, the gap between the dotted and solid curves indicates that unfreezing the KDA layers mitigates this gradient amplification. Notably, the gradient norm increases progressively rather than abruptly, suggesting that this amplification emerges from the evolving optimization dynamics rather than as an immediate consequence of freezing. This observation further supports Competing Learning, suggesting a self-reinforcing optimization mechanism in which the current parameter configuration determines the allocation of learning signals, progressively amplifying the advantages of already dominant components. See Appendix I.1 for more details.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步调查冻结措施如何影响梯度动态。 如图5所示,被冻结检查站的注意层的梯度规范大约达到基线检查站的10x10\次,而基线检查站从未被冻结。 此外,被点和固体曲线之间的差距表明,解冻KDA地层能减轻这种梯度放大. 值得注意的是,梯度规范逐渐增加,而不是突然增加,这表明这种扩大来自不断变化的优化动态,而不是冻结的直接后果。 这一观察进一步支持了相竞学习,提出一个自我增强优化机制,其中目前的参数配置决定了学习信号的分配,并逐渐地扩大了已经占支配地位的组件的优势. 详见附录一.1。

blocks.en: Freezing KDA progressively amplifies attention layers’ gradients, while unfreezing mitigates this effect. This supports Competing Learning: learning signals depend on the current ability gap of components, reinforcing the advantages of already dominant components.
blocks.zh: 冻结KDA逐渐地放大了注意力层的梯度,而解冻则会减轻这种影响. 这支持了相竞学习:学习信号依赖于当前组件的能力差距,强化了已经占优势的组件的优势.

blocks.en:
We further investigate how the distribution of gap ( g ) (g) in the training data influences the learnability of retrieval in different mixers.
To this end, we train the hybrid model using different mixture proportions of short-distance ( g = 64 g=64 ) and long-distance ( g = 8192 g=8192 ) examples. As shown in Figure 3 , attention layers become more important as the proportion of long-distance examples increases, whereas KDA layers are more likely to dominate when the long-distance patterns do not appear overwhelmingly more than short-distance patterns. This is because KDA initializes forget gates with low values, which gives this architecture a short-distance inductive bias (See Appendix B for a more specific explanation).
blocks.zh:
我们进一步调查培训数据中的差距(g)(g)的分布如何影响在不同混合器中检索的可学习性。
为此,我们利用短途(克=64克=64克)和长途(克=8192克=8192克=8192克)等不同比例的混合物来训练混合模型. 如图3所示,随着长途实例比例的上升,关注层变得更加重要,而当长途模式看起来并不压倒短途模式时,KDA层则更有可能占主导地位. 这是因为KDA初始化了低值的忘却门,这使得这种架构具有了短距离的诱导偏差(见附录B更具体的解释).

blocks.en: Different mixers learn retrieval at different speeds, depending on the data distribution. While both mixers can acquire the same retrieval abilities, the mixer that learns faster will become dominant, limiting the learning of the other mixer.
blocks.zh: 不同的混音器根据数据分布,以不同的速度学习回取. 虽然两个搅拌机都能获得相同的取回能力,但学习速度快的搅拌机会成为主导,限制了其他搅拌机的学习.

blocks.en: Applying the traditional training recipe to a hybrid model can lead to a suboptimal division of labor. Because short-distance patterns occur more frequently than long-distance patterns in natural language ( Futrell et al., 2015 ) , the training objective may encourage KDA to dominate retrieval, suppressing the training of attention layers. This issue is less problematic in homogeneous architectures such as Transformers, where all layers share the same architecture and, consequently, have the same potential for retrieval.
blocks.zh: 将传统训练配方应用到混合型模式中,会导致劳动分工不理想. 由于短途模式在自然语言中比长途模式更频繁地出现(Futrell等,2015年),因此培训目标可能鼓励KDA主导检索,抑制了注意力层的训练. 这个问题在"变形器"等同质建筑中存在较少的问题,所有地层都具有相同的建筑,因此具有相同的检索潜力.

blocks.en: 4 LLM Pretraining Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个LLM 预训实验

blocks.en: In this section, we show that we can leverage insights about Competing Learning to achieve improved LLM performance in natural language pre-training.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们显示,我们可以利用对相竞学习的洞察力,在自然语言预训中实现更好的LLM性能.

blocks.en: 4.1 Method: Better Layer Division
blocks.zh: 4.1 方法:更好的分层

blocks.en: Based on the analysis results in Section 3.3.1 , we propose Better Layer Division (BLD), which freezes RNN layers’ weights during the early stage of pretraining, thereby giving the attention layers a first-mover advantage in Competing Learning. Importantly, this intervention establishes a corrected division of labor between the two components, which is subsequently preserved and further reinforced throughout the remainder of pretraining. This better labor division translates to improved model performance.
blocks.zh: 基于第3.3.1节的分析结果,我们提议改善地层分区(BLD),该分区在预训初期冻结RNN地层的分量,从而使关注地层在相竞学习中具有先入为主的优势. 重要的是,这一干预措施确定了两个组成部分之间的纠正分工,随后在培训前的剩余时间里得到了保留和进一步加强。 这种较好的劳动分工意味着模型性能的改善.

blocks.zh: 4.2 实验细节

We train a family of KDA–attention hybrid models ranging from

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , BLD models achieve notably lower LM losses. They also show a modest improvement in CSR performance, while exhibiting substantial gains on retrieval-oriented tasks, including Recall and RULER. Moreover, the PPL metrics, which reflect overall long-context modeling capability, consistently favor BLD by a large margin. The specific subtask scores are included in Appendix F .

Specifically, we calculated next-token prediction loss on Books3,BookCorpus2 ( Gao et al., 2020 ) as a function of token positions, up to 16K. Figure 7 shows that BLD model has a lower loss especially in the later position, highlighting better context utilization abilities by BLD models. The results of all model sizes and other details are included in Appendix G .

blocks.en: 4.5 Evidence for Labor Division Change in Attention Scores
blocks.zh: 4.5 劳工处的证据

blocks.en: Figure 9: The α \alpha values of attention heads. With GQA, query heads 0–3 and 4–7 share a KV head within each group and therefore share the same KV-head-level α \alpha value. Greater α \alpha values indicate heads that are important for long-distance retrieval.

blocks.en: We further provide direct evidence that BLD induces stronger functional differentiation. Specifically, following Xiao et al. (2025) , we analyze 510M KDA-attention hybrid models by training α \alpha values to distinguish retrieval heads , which are responsible for long-distance information retrieval, from streaming heads , which primarily perform short-distance token mixing. α \alpha measures a head’s reliance on full-context attention, with larger values indicating greater reliance. In other words, heads with greater α \alpha values are more important for long-distance retrieval. The α \alpha values are trained for 1,000 steps. More experimental details and results are reported in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步提供了直接证据,证明BLD诱发更强烈的功能差异. 具体地说,跟随肖等人(2025年),我们通过训练α-α值来分析510M KDA-attention混合模型,以区分负责长途信息检索的取回头,取回头主要进行短途符号混合. α α 度量一个头对完整文字的依赖, 更大的值表示更大的依赖。 换句话说,具有较大α-α值的头对长途检索更为重要. α-α值被训练出1000步. 更多的实验细节和结果载于附录一。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 9 , the attention heads in the BLD model exhibit higher α \alpha values than those in the vanilla model, indicating that BLD contains more retrieval heads that attend to long-range tokens. Figure 7 reports model’s retrieval accuracy as attention heads are progressively masked in ascending order of their α \alpha values. For BLD, the accuracy remains largely unchanged as low- α \alpha heads are masked and drops sharply only when the final three heads, which have the highest α \alpha values, are removed. This suggests that these three heads play a critical role in retrieval, and we therefore identify them as retrieval heads. In contrast, the vanilla model exhibits a substantial accuracy drop only when its single highest- α \alpha head is masked, indicating that it contains only one retrieval head.
blocks.zh: 如图9所显示,BLD模型中的注意头显示的α-α值高于香草模型中的α-α值,表明BLD包含更多的检索头来关注长距离符. 图7报告模型的检索准确性,因为注意头按α-α值的上升顺序逐渐被掩盖。 对 BLD来说,准确性基本上保持不变,因为低-α-α-α头被遮住并急剧下降,只有在α-α值最高的最后三个头被去除后才出现. 这说明这三个头在取回中起着关键作用,因此我们认定它们为取回头. 相形之下,香草模型只有在其单高-α-α-α头被蒙上后,才显示出显著的精度下降,表明它只包含一个取回头.

blocks.en: BLD promotes a greater degree of functional specialization, with more attention heads specializing in long-range retrieval. This behavior aligns with the motivation underlying our method.
blocks.zh: BLD促进更高程度的功能专业化,更多的注意力头专门从事远程检索. 这种行为符合我们方法背后的动机

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we first identify the Competing Learning phenomenon and provide supporting experimental evidence. We then show that directly pretraining hybrid models can lead to a suboptimal division of labor among different architectural components. To address this issue, we propose BLD and validate its effectiveness through scalable experiments. By promoting a more effective division of labor, BLD consistently improves model capabilities across a wide range of dimensions.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们首先确定竞争学习现象,并提供辅助实验证据. 然后,我们显示,直接预先训练混合模型会导致不同建筑构件之间的分工不理想。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出BLD并通过可扩展实验验证其有效性. 通过促进更有效的分工,BLD在广泛的层面不断提高模型能力.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, BLD represents only a preliminary approach to addressing the Competing Learning phenomenon in the training of hybrid models. We believe that a deeper understanding of the Competing Learning phenomenon will provide further insights into the division of labor within hybrid architectures and inspire the development of more advanced neural architectures and training strategies that better account for this phenomenon and achieve stronger performance.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,BLD只是解决混合模式培训中的竞争学习现象的初步方法. 我们相信,更深入地了解相竞学习现象,将进一步深入了解混合结构内的分工,并激励制定更先进的神经结构和培训战略,以更好地说明这一现象并实现更强的业绩.
